notes:
Summary: Mid-market product org building in-app AI features (support assistant + code helper). Began on Redwood Hosted API (fast onboarding) then requested Dedicated for predictable costs and VPC. POC on Hosted completed; results looked promising but cost variability and high concurrent load during peak support hours led them to evaluate Dedicated.

POC key numbers:
- 3-week Hosted POC (Dec 2025) used chat + embeddings for triage flows
- Average monthly token projection for pilot: ~30M tokens/month
- Peak throughput observed on hosted: ~120 req/s for short bursts; steady-state ~30 req/s
- Latency targets: 95th pctile < 250ms for chat paths; < 150ms preferred for simple retrieval responses

Requirements called out on calls:
- Predictable monthly bill for product roadmap ("need a predictable monthly bill, not surprises")
- VPC deployment with private networking and KMS for key material
- SOC2 and audit logs; retention policy options and ability to meet EU data residency for some customers
- Model choices: prefer quantized Llama- or Mistral-family variants; fallback to smaller model when latency critical
- Intelligent prefix/KV caching and batching to reduce token costs

Pricing/packaging ask (explicit):
- Provide 3 committed tiers for Dedicated: small (pilot), mid (GA), large (scale) with monthly commit and defined burst pool
- Burst policy: at least 2x baseline for short windows (minutes) with clear overage pricing and throttling behavior
- Overage calc: want per-token overage (not per-request) and an example bill for projected 30M tokens/month with 25% burst
- Ramp schedule: 3-month pilot -> 6-month ramp to GA; want ability to increase commit quarterly without penalty for first year
- Request for trial Dedicated pricing (discounted) for 3 months to validate performance under real concurrency

Negotiation notes:
- Finance is price-sensitive; pointed to a target ARR impact of $200k-600k to justify Dedicated commit
- Procurement asks for SOW + SLA language around latency targets and rollback to hosted in case SLAs missed
- Legal requested sample SOW + data residency clauses; SE to provide draft pricing + SOW v2 by 2026-02-28

Open items / blockers:
- Need clear example invoices showing commit vs overage math (they flagged previous vendor surprises)
- Security questionnaire answers outstanding (infosec spreadsheet link in Drive)
- Internal budget owner not yet aligned; CFO expects itemized forecast for 12 months

Quote / customer voice:
- "If we can get a committed plan that lets us predict ops cost and still absorb spikes, we can move to Dedicated for Q2 rollouts."

Suggested Redwood play (internal):
- Send Dedicated pricing v2 with 3 commit tiers, explicit burst pool mechanics, per-token overage rate, and a 3-month discounted pilot. Include example invoice for 30M tokens/month + 25% burst. Fast-track SOC2 and KMS docs to Drive link. Schedule procurement + legal sync week of 2026-03-03.
